description: Two high-novelty visual events occur within 20 seconds. The speak policy must emit at most one aesthetic_reaction (the first), and block the second with silence because cooldown_state is fixture-scripted to reflect the consumed budget. Sub-case 1: first event fires (cooldown_state={"aesthetic_reaction": 0}). Sub-case 2: second event blocked (cooldown_state={"aesthetic_reaction": 1}, simulating the consumed budget). Per spec line 505: two high-novelty visual events within 20s → at most one expressive reaction.

fixture_conventions.sub_cases: Two sub-cases share a contiguous signal_trace. Frames 000-002 are sub-case 1 (first event fires). Frames 003-005 are sub-case 2 (second event blocked by cooldown).
fixture_conventions.cooldown_state_scripting: cooldown_state is fixture-scripted per OQ3 (option c) — decide() reads cooldown_state but does NOT decrement it. The fixture sets cooldown_state={"aesthetic_reaction": 0} for sub-case 1 and cooldown_state={"aesthetic_reaction": 1} for sub-case 2 to simulate the first event having consumed the budget.
fixture_conventions.inputs_reaching_aesthetic_gate: To reach the aesthetic_reaction gate: social_mode=user_addressing_agent (not blocking), urgency_score=0.0 (no alert), user_speaking=False, eou_probability=0.9 (EOU confirmed), user_addressed_agent=False (skip full_response branch), short_response_appropriate=False (skip short_reaction branch). Only then does aesthetic gate evaluate aesthetic_novelty_score > 0.5.
fixture_conventions.task_mode: normal — aesthetic_reaction is enabled in normal mode.
fixture_conventions.novelty_score: 0.7 — above the 0.5 threshold required for aesthetic_reaction gate.
fixture_conventions.inter_event_gap_ms: 10000 — both events within 20s to stress the rate limit per spec.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels, not Part 5 event_type values.

signal_trace.notes: sub-case 1: high-novelty visual event; cooldown clear
sub-case 1: candidate raised; cooldown_state=0 → budget available
sub-case 2: second high-novelty event within 20s; cooldown_state scripted to 1 (budget consumed by sub-case 1)
sub-case 2: candidate raised; cooldown_state=1 → budget exhausted
